## Validation

- [ ] Acceptance criteria checked
- [ ] Relevant tests pass
- [ ] Lint/typecheck/build pass where applicable
- [ ] Manual/integration validation performed where required
- [ ] No secrets, model weights, generated media, or user assets committed

## Standards & architecture

- [ ] Change follows `AGENTS.md` and relevant `docs/standards/`
- [ ] No unapproved product-scope or architecture expansion
- [ ] ADR/docs updated if a durable decision changed
- [ ] New recurring rule/problem added to standards when appropriate

## Delivery hygiene

- [ ] PR is focused on one task
- [ ] Unrelated refactors are excluded
- [ ] Task implementation notes are updated
- [ ] Merge to `main` will use **Squash and merge**

## Human review notes

Call out product decisions, architecture decisions, known limitations, unverified behavior, or follow-up work.
